card.name: Title words inside table and heading text
card.fires_on: Words inside headings and table titles, especially just before the title continues, such as 'Dosage Modifications' after 'Table 2:'. Also fires on list-style headline text run together with no break.

modes.label: Table titles
modes.description: Words in a 'Table 2:' caption where the title is still going, such as Dosage Modifications.
modes.example: Table 2: Recommended Dosage<< Modifications>> for Hepatotoxicity Hepatotoxic

modes.label: Headline fragments
modes.description: Words in run-together headings or titles of articles and trials, often partway through a word.
